candidates.title: Keep the keyboard reveal flush with the source edge?
criteria: After Down scrolls, is the bottom of the selected row flush with the bottom of the source view?
candidates.content: Launch the frozen build below. Select a source line around lines 500–600 and use Down or hold Down until navigation scrolls. The selected row should meet the bottom edge directly above the horizontal scrollbar, with no extra row or gap below it. Continue Down and Shift-Down: each scrolling step should move exactly one row. An already fully visible target should stay put. Try Up at the top edge and split/unified view as part of this same edge-reveal judgment. The top of the viewport may retain a partial row so the selected row fits the bottom exactly. Accept to keep this reveal, or Reject and describe the change in the note. After saving, use Finish and hand back.
